booleans-on-swept-carriers.label: Boolean algebra over lofted/swept/revolved (non-canonical-carrier) geometry
booleans-on-swept-carriers.note: Canonical-by-canonical booleans are landed; sweep/swept-carrier pairs unlock with the BIE program's sweep-pair certification (BIE-006). A row that boolean-composes lofted/swept shells is not runnable at this program stage and carries this typed reason; the reason row is the machine-checked evidence.

step-out.label: STEP export out of constructive/swept geometry
step-out.note: STEP out of constructive/swept surfaces is a typed kernel refusal; STL covers render and print. A row whose export target is STEP-only behind this boundary carries this typed reason.
